title: Steve's Lava Chicken
blurb: 'Steve's lava chicken, spicy!' — Jack Black's fourteen-second Minecraft Movie song that charted internationally and became the most quoted thing in any playground. It's absurdly short, absurdly catchy, and absurdly successful: an actual charting single about chicken cooked in lava. Play it and watch every child in earshot complete the lyric automatically.
origin: Jack Black's viral song from A Minecraft Movie (2025).
